description.en: Returns the character handle of a challenge NPC by its index. The challenge NPCs of a map (the characters that start a match when talked to) are kept in a table of the script system, by index; the challenge script ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut uses these commands.

The handle (0 if the entry is empty).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: After a challenge match (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut)
